parameters.content:
## 1 · Timesheets: chase → approve → payroll export
Monday: text every temp with a missing timesheet. Temp submits hours on a mobile form → client manager approves in one click → temp gets a text. Friday: approved hours → payroll and invoicing CSV.
In a live agency, "Load data" and the update nodes talk to the ATS and payroll instead of the demo tables.

### Run from the demo console
The console sends run = chase or export.

### Monday 09:00: chase missing timesheets
Texts each temp a secure link, reminds client managers to approve, emails the consultant a summary.

### Friday 12:00: payroll export
Approved hours → CSV with pay, charge and margin per worker (PAYE or umbrella), saved to files/payroll-exports.

### Temp opens the SMS link
Mobile form with hours per day.

### Temp submits hours
Saves the hours, emails the client manager a one-click approval link, shows the temp a confirmation.

### Client manager approves or queries
Approve → temp gets a text. Query → consultant gets an alert and the temp can resubmit.

### Download a payroll CSV
Only exact export file names are accepted.

meta.description: Chases missing timesheets by SMS, takes hours from a mobile form, gets one-click client approval and exports approved hours for payroll.
